evidenceKind: read-only local-chain snapshot and receipt verification

eventWindow.coverageNote: Includes every event log emitted by the listed escrow, arbitration, randomness, USDC, and WBTC addresses in the pinned block window. Chain logs do not encode UI origin; this is an event/receipt scope, not proof that each transaction came from a particular browser action.

jobEnumeration.note: Enumerated job ids 26 through jobCount-1 with jobCount read at the same pinned block used for all contract calls.

historicalUiProofReferenceReconciliation.note: These are references from earlier browser proof files. A missing current-chain receipt means the old transaction is not present on this live chain snapshot; it does not change the separate current event-window result.

baselineJob31Withdrawal.jobAssociationSource: The proof records jobId 31 and exactWithdrawal hash; WithdrawalCompleted itself has no jobId field.
